title: Service Detail: Frontend / Editor / Backend Field Parity Audit
architectureNote: There is no Prisma/Zod schema for services. Content.ts and Page.ts store content as mongoose.Schema.Types.Mixed, and PUT /api/content writes the request body verbatim. A field can never be 'missing from the database' in the validation sense - Mongo stores whatever key is sent. The real failure mode is a field the template renders that the editor never exposes an input for, leaving it stuck on a hardcoded fallback.

structuralRisk.summary: Two independent, hand-duplicated editors maintain the same content shape with no shared source of truth.
structuralRisk.evidence: Commit bcab5f4 renamed whyChooseUs.points -> list and popular -> isPopular only inside admin/services/page.tsx, because ServiceDetailEditor.tsx already used the correct names - proof the two files already drifted apart once.

findings.issue: Hero CTA buttons rendered by the template have no inputs anywhere in the editor; only a hardcoded default is set once at seed time.

Drives the FAQ section header and JSON-LD schema markup; read directly off the service record but has no inputs in this editor. Editable in the parallel admin/services/page.tsx editor, confirming divergence.
Used for the trust marquee logo art; only 'name' is editable.
Rendered per roadmap card; only seeded as a constant when a new step is added, never exposed as an editable input afterward.
Rendered on industry cards when set; only present as one-time seed defaults, never exposed as inputs.
Rendered as the M01/M02 badge on metric cards; no input in the metrics editor. Degrades gracefully to an auto M0# default, so lower severity.
Editable and normalized but never rendered anywhere in the template JSX. Dead field.
Normalized on the template side but never read - differentiator rows always render a static check icon. Correctly not exposed in the editor; worth pruning from normalization.
Recommended-service icons are chosen purely from slug via getServiceIcon(); the stored .icon value from DEFAULT_SERVICE_TEMPLATE is never read.
Normalized on the template side but not settable in the editor. Low confidence it renders downstream via PageInlineFaqs - not inspected in this audit.

confirmedInSync: whyChooseUs.list (renamed from .points) and pricing.plans[].isPopular (renamed from .popular) - correct in ServiceDetailEditor.tsx; drift only ever existed in admin/services/page.tsx, patched separately
industries list core fields (title/desc/iconName/watermark) - fully synced aside from footer gap (finding 5)
Roadmap 'unused deliverables' cleanup - dead hardcoded constant removed from template; steps[].deliverables[] remains correctly wired in both files
pricing.plans[].{badgeText,isCustom,ctaLink} - full parity confirmed including checkboxes in editor UI
recommendedNextSteps: Fix the two critical gaps: add hero CTA inputs and the five FAQ meta fields to ServiceDetailEditor.tsx
Fix the four medium gaps: expose logo icon/image, step footers, industries footers, and metric tag as real inputs
Resolve the structural risk: decide whether admin/services/page.tsx or ServiceDetailEditor.tsx is canonical, then delete the other or extract a shared field schema both consume
Prune the minor dead fields once the above is settled
